select_jsonl_columns: select specific columns from a JSONL file and output tab-separated values
filter_jsonl_with_where: filter JSONL documents using Python expressions like len({text}) > 100
merge_columns_to_json: merge tab-separated columns back into JSON objects with type annotations
describe_jsonl_dataset: compute statistics and histograms for fields in a JSONL dataset
split_jsonl_by_field: split a JSONL file into multiple files based on the value of a field
